ancient-sites-and-mysteries.summary: 4 sites in Aswan. Abu Simbel and Kom Ombo prices are from the November 2024 price list; a booking site shows higher Abu Simbel prices, not recorded.

layers.process: Abu Simbel: foreign adult EGP 750 (about A$19.47), student EGP 375 (about A$9.74), at A$1 = about EGP 38.51 (Central Bank of Egypt average market rate for USD on 4 November 2026, EGP 54.70 mid, crossed with the RBA rate of 30 October 2026, A$1 = USD 0.7040). On 22 February and 22 October the price is higher: adult EGP 1,200 (about A$31.16), student EGP 600. Open 6 am to 5 pm. Vehicles: car or taxi EGP 25, minibus EGP 50, coaster EGP 75, bus EGP 100.
Philae: foreign adult EGP 550 (about A$14.28), student EGP 275; the temple panorama is a separate EGP 200 adult, EGP 100 student. Open 7 am to 4 pm.
Smartraveller says road travel to Abu Simbel, 40 km north of the Sudanese border, can be dangerous, and that if you go you should only travel with an organised tour guarded by police escorts.

laws.rule: Nubia Museum: The page says private photography follows its ticket conditions; commercial photography/video needs the competent authority's permission. No flash, and camera-holder use has its own ticket condition. Do not touch exhibits/showcases. Food and drinks are excluded from galleries except small water bottles. Bags/luggage larger than 40 by 40 cm are excluded from galleries and directed to the cloakroom. Follow posted instructions; this is the museum's visitor policy, not a governorate-wide photography or luggage rule.

culture-and-protocol.photography_and_story_permissions: The page says private photography follows its ticket conditions; commercial photography/video needs the competent authority's permission. No flash, and camera-holder use has its own ticket condition. The page asks visitors to refrain from photographing other visitors or staff because of personal rights; this is not rewritten as a universal criminal prohibition.
